description: This file contains unit tests for the harvester RBus API, verifying functions like handle retrieval, initialization, value fetching, and data model registration. It uses Google Test framework with mock objects to simulate interactions with the RTOS bus and related components.

classes.name: HarvesterTestFixture
classes.description: Test fixture class for setting up mocks and environments for HARVESTER RBus API unit tests.

methods.name: TestGetRbusHandle
methods.description: Verifies that get_rbus_handle correctly returns the assigned handle.

methods.name: TestRbusInitializedCheck_Uninitialized

methods.name: RbusGetStringValue_Success
